skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts, principles, and procedures of land use investment project evaluation.
Understand the legal basis for evaluating land use investment projects.
Analyze the financial feasibility of land use investment projects.
Evaluate the economic and social impacts of land use investment projects.
Assess the environmental impact of land use investment projects.
Evaluate the suitability of different sites for land use investment projects.
Apply various methods for evaluating land use investment projects.
Develop critical thinking skills to assess the feasibility and impacts of land use investment projects.
Work collaboratively in teams to evaluate land use investment projects.
Demonstrate self-directed learning in understanding and applying project evaluation concepts.
Analyze data related to land use investment projects.
Write comprehensive reports on the evaluation of land use investment projects.
